AlphaREAD Interactive Reading Curriculum

Welcome to AlphaREAD (formerly AlphabetGO)! Our interactive educational platform provides a comprehensive reading curriculum for children. Students learn to read through engaging voice-evaluated lessons, syllable builders, and spelling activities.

Core features include:

  • Interactive phonics and CVC word blending.
  • Voice recognition evaluation for reading accuracy.
  • Comprehensive curriculum from alphabet mastery to sentence reading.
  • Teacher and admin dashboards for tracking student progress.

Please enable JavaScript to access the full interactive application.
